title: Confirm the full resolution above?
body: This is the complete resolution, built from your answers in rounds 1 to 3. If you confirm, I will post it on Choose validation and delivery ownership, close the ticket, and add a line to the map's Decisions so far. I will also add a pointer to the map's Notes, a v2 line for no-mistakes to Out of scope, and the fog changes listed under Map follow-through. Define v1 acceptance scenarios and evidence gets a short 'Narrowed by' section. No new ticket is created. If anything is wrong or missing, choose the second option and say what in the notes.
rec: Confirm and record, if it matches what you decided.
